notes: Sneaking in exploration (designer decision, 2026-10-09). Book (Captain's Log p.74): Control is the attribute for remaining stealthy; the books have no real-time stealth rules. Prototype: sneak skill = Control + Security, as for the combat Ambush (combatAmbush.js). Every number here is first-pass tuning, not a book value.
Toggled per character (the C key or the Sneak button, for the selected characters). A sneaking character never runs: a long move order still sneaks.

Each character uses their own skill. speed: tiles per second = baseSpeed + perPoint x (skill - referenceSkill), kept between min and max (walking is partyControl.json walkSpeed). A follower who falls behind catches up at catchUpFactor times their sneak speed.

detection: how fast an NPC's awareness of a sneaking character builds. It replaces awareness.json's movingMultiplier / runningMultiplier with movingMultiplier (moving) or stillMultiplier (standing still), then multiplies by the skill factor = 1 - perPoint x (skill - referenceSkill), kept between minFactor and maxFactor. Inside an NPC's closeRange a sneaking character is still identified at once.
